main_text.p: קִרְסִים m. p. Ansulae, à Reflexa forma.
קִרְסַל masc. Talus, Malleolus pedis: plurale קִרְסֻלִים.
קָרַע Rumpere, Lacerare. Niphal נִקְרַע Rumpi. Findi, Lacerari.
קְרָעִים m. p. Ruptura, Rupta, Fragmenta, Lacera vestimenta.
קָרַץ Incidere, Concidere: Nictare, Annuere: Pyhal קֻרַץ Excidi, Decidi.
קִרְצָא, קִרְצָא Obtrectatio, Detatio, Calumnia, Crimen, Accusatio, quasi honoris alterius Excisio.
קֶרֶשׁ קְרֶשׁ m. Asser, Tabula: plur. קְרָשִׁים.
מִקְשָׁה m. Cucumerarium, cum ה loco א.
קָשַׁב Auscultavit, Attendit, Intentus fuit. Hiphil הִקְשִׁיב idem.
קֶשֶׁב m. Attentio. קְשֵׁבָה f. Intenta. קְשֵׁבוֹת Attenta.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vocalisation reconstructed where the scan is faint; several marks on the page are blots and were ignored. Bottom-of-page marks are a digitiser's line and were left out.
